title: Distribution catalogues
purpose: Find and maintain the consent forms used by consent records.
summary: The consent form versions consent records are recorded on.

tasks.title: Add a consent form version
steps: Admin and manager: select [[New consent form]], or Add consent form on the study.

good_to_know: Each version is its own entry. A changed form is a new version.
Every consent on a version answers each category it asks.
If more than 10,000 rows match, narrow the filters to see [[Export CSV]].

sections.title: Tabs
paragraphs: Scope categories, Consent forms, Institutions and Investigators are the four distribution catalogues. Entries have no record page: for admin and manager the code opens the entry's edit form; for others it is plain text.

items.label: Code
items.description: Opens the edit form for admin and manager.

items.label: Version
items.description: Each version is its own entry.

items.label: Categories asked
items.description: The scope categories every consent on this version answers.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active or Inactive. Inactive entries stay on existing records but are not offered for new ones.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active (default), Inactive, or Active and inactive.

items.label: Study
items.description: Only the forms of one study.

items.label: Search, filters, Apply, Clear all
items.description: Search and the filters narrow the rows on the server; Apply runs them and Clear all removes every filter and the search. Active filters show as chips you can remove one by one. An invalid filter shows an error and no rows rather than everything.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Shows or hides columns for you; the first column stays.

items.label: Sorting and paging
items.description: Click a sortable heading to sort; click again to reverse. Rows per page: 25, 50 or 100. The count under the table is the number of rows matching the filters.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads all matching rows across pages as UTF-8 CSV, using the current filters and sort. Export CSV appears when the filters are valid and up to 10,000 rows match. Correct any filter errors before exporting. For a larger selection, the list shows the row limit. If the selection grows past the limit before you download, you return to this list with the same filters and sort. Narrow the selection and try again. Text that starts like a spreadsheet formula gets a leading apostrophe. The audit trail records who downloaded the selection, the filters and the number of data rows in the file. With no matches, the CSV contains only the header and the audit count is zero.

sections.title: Actions and access
paragraphs: Every staff role (admin, manager, technician, viewer) can open this page. Only admin and manager see and can use the buttons that change records; the server refuses the change to anyone else.
New consent form (admin and manager) opens the catalogue form.
